displayName: Block multiple automatic downloads in quick succession on specific sites
description:
Define a list of sites, based on URL patterns, where multiple successive automatic downloads aren't allowed.
If you don't configure this policy, "DefaultAutomaticDownloadsSetting" applies for all sites, if it's set.  If it isn't set, then the user's personal setting applies.
For more detailed information about valid URL patterns, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2095322.
